title: Platformer
prompt:
Build a side-view platformer whose built-in level has at least 3 coins, spikes and a goal flag; the camera follows the hero. The hero (a box up to 32x48) has gravity, walks at most 6 units per tick and jumps only from the ground (no double jump), rising between 64 and 200 units. Platforms are solid from every side. A coin is collected when its point is within 16 units of the hero box (+10). Touching spikes or falling below the level (y > height) immediately costs one of 3 lives (no invulnerability) and respawns the hero at start; 0 lives ends the game with won false. Touching the goal ends it with won true. Keyboard: arrows/A/D walk, Space/ArrowUp/W jump. Touch: hold the left or right third to walk, tap the middle third to jump.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, lives, won, coins (left), player:{x, y, w, h (top-left box), vx, vy, onGround}}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.press(name): hold 'left' or 'right'
- Game.input.release(name): release it
- Game.input.jump(): jump if on the ground
- Game.loadLevel(level): replace the level with {width, height, start:{x,y}, platforms:[{x,y,w,h}], coins:[{x,y}], spikes:[{x,y,w,h}], goal:{x,y,w,h}}; the hero appears at start
- Game.debug.setPlayer(x, y): move the hero (top-left) with zero velocity

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): landing, walking, jumping, solid walls, coins, spikes, pits, goal, keyboard and touch.
